Texas Triangle Property — 5+ Acres

16,048 for-sale parcels · Realtor.com snapshot, October 18, 2026 · 5,525 inside the triangle, 10,523 in the 50-mile ring

About this data Coverage. Every Realtor.com for-sale listing with a lot of 5+ acres (land, farm/ranch, houses on acreage, mobile, multi-family; condo/townhome units excluded because they report the shared complex lot), searched county by county across the 86 Texas counties that touch the triangle or its 50-mile ring; pending and contingent listings excluded. Only Realtor.com is covered, so listings exclusive to other land sites are missing. Locations. Coordinates are Realtor.com's own; listings Realtor.com publishes without coordinates are geocoded to their street, ZIP or city center and marked ~approx (1,853 of 16,048). Zone classification (inside vs 50-mile ring) uses that point. Triangle. Vertices at Dallas (32.78, -96.80), San Antonio (29.42, -98.49), Houston (29.76, -95.37); the ring is 50 statute miles from the triangle edges.
